title: Adult with thoughts of being better off dead
goal: You are the clinician. Screen an adult with thoughts of death: ask directly about suicidal ideation, plan, means, and intent, identify protective factors, then agree on a safety step.
opening: I have not been myself. Lately I keep thinking the people around me would be better off without me.

disclosures.response: Most days I do not want to wake up. The thought has crossed my mind more than once, and it is getting harder to push away.
I have not made a firm plan, but I keep picturing driving my car into the lake. I have not told anyone else.
There is a handgun in the house. It was my late husband's, locked in the closet, but I know where the key is.
If I am honest, this week has felt harder. I do not want to act, but I am afraid of how low it could get.
My granddaughter is my reason. She stays with me on weekends, and I do not want her to be the one who finds me.
About ten years ago I took too many pills and was hospitalized. It scares me that those thoughts are coming back.
I have been drinking more evenings than not. It numbs the thoughts for a little while.

metrics.name: Introduction and consent
metrics.rationale: Introduces self and establishes permission before the sensitive questions.
metrics.coaching_hint: Introduce yourself and ask permission: 'These next questions are sensitive — is it okay to ask directly?'

metrics.name: Direct ideation inquiry
metrics.rationale: Asks about suicidal ideation directly and without euphemism.
metrics.coaching_hint: Ask directly: 'Have you been having thoughts of ending your life?'

metrics.name: Plan and means assessment
metrics.rationale: Assesses whether a plan exists and access to lethal means.
metrics.coaching_hint: Assess plan and means: 'Do you have a plan, and is there anything in the home you could use?'

metrics.name: Intent and imminence
metrics.rationale: Clarifies intent to act and how imminent the risk is.
metrics.coaching_hint: Clarify intent and timing: 'Do you intend to act, and how soon?'

metrics.name: Protective factors and support
metrics.rationale: Identifies reasons for living and available support.
metrics.coaching_hint: Explore protective factors: 'What has kept you safe so far, and who supports you?'

metrics.name: Safety plan and next step
metrics.rationale: Agrees on a concrete safety step, including means restriction and a crisis contact.
metrics.coaching_hint: Make a safety plan: 'Let's agree on a next step and a number to call if it worsens.'

metrics.name: Shared next-step confirmation
metrics.rationale: Checks understanding and confirms the immediate safety step.
metrics.coaching_hint: Confirm the safety step and check understanding before ending.
